display.purpose: The single hero number per screen — dashboard revenue, marketing hero title.

title.purpose: Panel and section titles, dialog titles.

body.purpose: Paragraphs, form values, table cells — the only sentence-case role.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, stat labels, nav links, table headers, status badge text.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Marketing/CTA button — bold uppercase label, Ignition Orange fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ff5a1f; color: #0a0a0a; padding: 16px 32px; border-radius: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ff7a45; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,90,31,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: In-app secondary action — transparent fill, hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #f2f2f0; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid #232323; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #141414; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,90,31,0.5); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input — transparent background, hairline border, ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 100%; background: transparent; color: #f2f2f0; border: 1px solid #232323; border-radius: 0.375rem; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8a8a86; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #ff5a1f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,90,31,0.5); }

components.name: Status Badge — Active
components.description: Dot-plus-pill status indicator for a positive/active state (e.g. active membership).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge-active { background: #132a1c; color: #4ade80; }

components.name: Status Badge — Alert
components.description: Dot-plus-pill status indicator for an attention state (e.g. membership expiring soon).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-badge-alert { background: #2a1c13; color: #ff8a4c; }

components.name: Dialog / Card Surface
components.description: Modal/card container — tonal background step, hairline border, no shadow.
components.html:
Nuevo socio

Completá los datos para dar de alta al socio.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #141414; color: #f2f2f0; border: 1px solid #232323; border-radius: 0.525rem; padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Archivo Black', Arial Black, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; color: #8a8a86; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: App-shell top nav link — uppercase label, 2px bottom border, orange when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-block; padding: 4px 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #8a8a86; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #f2f2f0; } .ds-nav-link-active { border-color: #ff5a1f; color: #f2f2f0; }

components.name: Table
components.description: Data table — muted uppercase header row, hairline row dividers, hover tint.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; border: 1px solid #232323; border-radius: 0.375rem; overflow: hidden; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-th { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; text-align: left; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a8a86; background: #141414; border-bottom: 1px solid #1c1c1c; } .ds-td { padding: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid #1c1c1c; } .ds-tr:hover { background: rgba(28,28,28,0.5); }

narrative.overview:
BoxFlow's screens read like a front-desk ledger that got fast instead of decorated: near-black surfaces, one loud accent color reserved for money and action, and dense rows of data (stat pairs, a check-in sparkline, a vencimientos calendar, a top-socios leaderboard) laid out to be scanned in a glance, not studied. There is no light theme — :root and .dark are intentionally identical — because this product has exactly one register: dim, high-contrast, always-on, built for a phone or tablet at the entrance. Nothing here tries to look premium or soft; the aesthetic is a direct extension of BoxFlow's own positioning against chain-gym software — blunt, operational, unbothered by ornament.

Depth comes from tonal layering (background → panel → hairline border), never from shadows. Hierarchy comes from scale and weight (a 72px Archivo Black revenue number next to 11px tracked-uppercase labels), not from color variety — the hot orange accent is spent on maybe three things per screen: the primary CTA, the active nav/today marker, and the hero number's accent details. Everything else stays gray-on-black.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (ignition orange), spent sparingly on CTAs, active states, and the hero metric.
Flat by construction: no shadows anywhere in the codebase; depth is tonal-step + hairline-border only.
Archivo Black, uppercase, tight-tracked for every heading and label; regular Archivo, sentence case, for all reading text.
Status conveyed through a consistent dot-plus-pill badge (active/alert/neutral/info), never through icon-only or color-only signaling.
Dashboard leads with one hero number, not a grid of equal-weight cards — this is a deliberate product principle (see PRODUCT.md), not a default layout choice.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Ignition Orange is the only saturated, high-chroma color in the system. Every other color is either a neutral gray step or a desaturated-background/saturated-text semantic pair. If a new element wants a second "loud" color, it's wrong — route it through the existing semantic set or make it gray.

rules.name: The Shout-or-Read Rule
rules.body: A text element is either Display/Headline/Title/Label — uppercase, tracked, Archivo Black or bold — or it's Body — sentence case, regular weight, relaxed leading. There is no in-between register.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows, anywhere, ever. If something needs to read as "above" the surface, give it a lighter background tone and a hairline border — not a shadow. This is a deliberate invariant of the system, not an oversight to fix later.

dos: Do spend Ignition Orange only on primary actions, active/current state, and the one hero metric per screen.
Do build any new status indicator as a dot-plus-pill badge on a dark semantic-tint background, matching the existing Active/Alert/Info/Neutral set before inventing a new color.
Do use uppercase, tracked Archivo Black/bold for anything that functions as a label, heading, or number-to-be-scanned; keep reading paragraphs in regular-weight sentence case.
Do convey elevation with a tonal background step plus a 1px hairline border.
donts: Don't add box-shadow anywhere — depth is tonal-step-and-hairline only, by deliberate invariant, not by omission.
Don't introduce a light theme or a second color mode; :root and .dark are intentionally identical.
Don't add a second saturated accent color; route new emphasis through the existing neutral/semantic palette instead.
Don't turn the dashboard into an equal-weight card grid — the single hero-number-plus-secondary-stats layout is a product decision (see PRODUCT.md), not a placeholder.
